newsitem.title: GREECE: Bank of Greece sets new rules on solvency ratio.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Greece sets new rules on solvency ratio.

text.p: Bank of Greece governor Lucas Papademos signed a decree that amends and supplements national law pertaining to local credit institutions' solvency ratio, in line with EU directives, it said.

The decree specifies the types of settlement that will be recognised by the central bank to reduce the credit risk of banks relating to forex and interest rate contracts and assigns the risk weights to be used in solvency ratio calculations.

Interamerican Investment Corporation is classified as a multi-facet investment bank. Therefore other Greek banks will enjoy a reduced risk weight of 20 percent compared to 100 percent against it in calculating their solvency ratio. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
